why: Gate scarcity rates are invalid if UNKNOWN or prerequisite-driven NOT_EVALUABLE rows are silently counted as failures or if overlap-observable rows are confused with rows that Formal would actually reach.

observerPopulation.definition: All rows with a same-scan gate observer receipt.
observerPopulation.forbiddenUse: Do not compute gate harshness as FAIL / all rows without separately reporting UNKNOWN/NOT_EVALUABLE/applicability.

evaluableDenominator.definition: Current gate status is PASS or FAIL.
evaluableDenominator.caveat: May include explicit PASS states that mean not-applicable/automatically clear; use applicableDenominator for semantic gate severity.

applicableDenominator.definition: Rows where the gate condition actually applies and is evaluable. Exclude semantic not-applicable clear states and prerequisite-driven NOT_EVALUABLE.
applicableDenominator.caveat: Applicability rules are gate-specific and versioned.

formalReachDenominator.definition: All earlier Formal gates are CLEAR (PASS or preregistered safe skip) and the current gate is evaluable/applicable.
formalReachDenominator.use: Sequential incidence under current Formal gate order.
formalReachDenominator.caveat: Still not marginal effect of removing the gate.

overlapDenominator.definition: Current gate is evaluable/applicable regardless of earlier observed fails.
overlapDenominator.use: Simultaneous blocker structure and co-failure matrix.
overlapDenominator.caveat: A row may never have reached this gate in production Formal.

stateAccounting.PASS: Clear for the observer; may need not-applicable reason check for applicable-rate denominator.
stateAccounting.UNKNOWN: Evidence/readiness missing; excluded from fail-rate denominators and reported separately.
stateAccounting.NOT_EVALUABLE: Gate cannot be semantically evaluated under captured prerequisites; excluded from fail-rate denominators.
safeNotApplicableExamples: SMALL_CAP_SPECIAL: marketCap>=30 is PASS with NOT_APPLICABLE_CAP_GTE_30
MID_CAP_LIQUIDITY: marketCap>=100 is PASS with NOT_APPLICABLE_CAP_GTE_100
VALUATION_RELATIVE_RISK: NO_POSITIVE_TTM_PE is NOT_EVALUABLE but replay treats it as a safe skip

gateMatrix.inputContract: marketCap 10-30 requires volume + institutionalScore; >=30 is clear/not-applicable
positive PE + positive sector median; high relative PE needs growth context
formal channel must exist; targetState FOUND/NONE

dependencyExamples.rule: AB_SETUP FAIL => TARGET_AVAILABLE NOT_EVALUABLE => REWARD_RISK NOT_EVALUABLE => FINAL_SIGNAL_GRADE NOT_EVALUABLE. Only AB_SETUP is an observed fail in this dependency path unless separate same-scan evidence makes later gates evaluable under their own contract.
count<3 => component-count FAIL and quality NOT_EVALUABLE; do not count the row as both fundamental-count fail and fundamental-quality fail.

Low-volume rows can require exception inputs; missing exception evidence remains UNKNOWN, not FAIL. Size-conditioned gates have their own applicability and must not inherit the liquidity fail denominator mechanically.

reportingMinimum.coFailure: pairwise/multi-gate observed FAIL combinations reported separately from firstFailureCount
reportingMinimum.provenance: gate observer version + Formal gate-order version + scan generation/coverage
reportingMinimum.zeroRule: No denominator of zero may be coerced to 0% fail; report UNKNOWN/NO_DENOMINATOR.

firstFailureFirewall.observedFailCount: Same-scan overlap count, not marginal contribution.
firstFailureFirewall.uniqueObservedClear: Single-removal replay state, not recovered Selected.
firstFailureFirewall.marginalSelectedEffect: UNKNOWN until a valid same-PIT counterfactual selection/ranking/quota replay is preregistered and validated.

falsificationTargets: Any report where FUNDAMENTAL_COMPONENT_COUNT fail also increments FUNDAMENTAL_QUALITY fail solely because score is unavailable is invalid.
Any report where TARGET_AVAILABLE fail/not-evaluable is also treated as RR fail is invalid.
Any gate comparison that ranks gates by raw fail counts without coverage/applicability/formal-reach denominators is not promotion-grade.
Any UNKNOWN-as-FAIL conversion violates the existing observer tests.

implementationAssessment.prospectiveFullPopulationPersistence: Class B proposal-first if needed for production coverage
